name: ATLANTIS (Team Atlanta, AIxCC winner)
one_liner: Cyber reasoning system mixing LLM agents with fuzzers and program analysis; each LLM-made input or patch is tested by running it.

loop.proposes: Fuzz seeds, payload generator scripts and source patches, from LLM agents
loop.judged_by: Running the code: coverage, sanitizer crashes as proof of a bug, patch checks against crash and tests
loop.steers: Coverage feedback refines scripts (up to four rounds); failed patches guide the next try; seeds join a corpus

headline_result: Won the DARPA AIxCC final at DEF CON 33 (August 2025) with 392.76 points; the team's paper reports 43 of 70 vulnerabilities found. DARPA's overall figures (all teams): 54 of 63 synthetic vulnerabilities found and 43 patched, 18 real-world bugs found, about $152 average per task.
caveat: Scores and counts come from the team's own paper plus DARPA's page, which differ (70 versus 63 challenges after a DARPA correction). The competition used synthetic bugs inserted into open-source projects. Real-world finds are small in number.
beyond_harness_note: The system is a program-analysis and fuzzing pipeline that calls LLM modules, and sanitizers and tests, not an LLM, decide whether a bug or patch counts.
generative_model: Several commercial LLMs used by agents (models vary by module)
algorithmic_authority: Fuzzers, sanitizers, PoV replay and project tests

sources.title: ATLANTIS: AI-driven Threat Localization, Analysis, and Triage Intelligence System
DARPA: AI Cyber Challenge marks pivotal inflection point for cyber defense

verification.notes: Read the arXiv abstract, the PDF text (Team Atlanta paper: Generator agent 'repeating up to four rounds', Evaluator runs PoV tests and internal test suites and reports failures back; Table 4 392.76 points, 43/70) and DARPA's results page. Note the discrepancy: the paper says 43/70, DARPA's corrected page says 63 challenges and its 54 found and 43 patched are all teams combined, so '43 of 70' must not be mixed with DARPA's totals. Place and prize ($4M) from DARPA. Not verified: team member institutions.
